MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000387
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00639125
THE BANK OF NEW YORK MELLON
TRUST COMPANY, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION FKA THE BANK OF NEW
YORK TRUST COMPANY, N.A. AS
SUCCESSOR TO JPMORGAN CHASE
BANK, N.A., AS TRUSTEE FOR RAMP
2004-RS10, is the Plaintiff, and
MAHESHINDER S. GHUMAN, ET
ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 02/05/2026.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 6TH DAY of MAY
A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty
o' clock by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the BOROUGH of SAYREVILLE in
the County of MIDDLESEX, State of
New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 3273
WASHINGTON ROAD, SAYREVILLE,
NJ 08859.
Being Known as: Lot 589 & 590,
Block 340.02 on the official Tax Map
of the BOROUGH OF SAYREVILLE.
Dimensions: 48FT. X 123FT.
Nearest Cross Street: HARRISON PL.
The occupancy status of the property is: OCCUPIED BY TENANT.
Plaintiff's good faith estimate of its
upset price is: $133,039.99.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the
right to adjourn this sale without
further notice by publication.
*Subject to any unpaid taxes,
municipal liens or other charges,
and any such taxes, charges, liens,
insurance premiums or other
advances made by Plaintiff prior to
this sale. All interested parties are
to conduct and rely upon their own
independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or
have priority over the lien being
foreclosed and, if so, the current
amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any
reason, the Purchaser at the sale
shall be entitled only to a return of
the deposit paid. The Purchaser
shall have no further recourse
against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's attorney.
*** if after the sale and satisfaction
of the mortgage debt, including
costs and expenses, there remains
any surplus money, the money will
be deposited into the Superior
Court Trust Fund and any person
claiming the surplus, or any part
thereof, may file a motion pursuant
to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2
stating the nature and extent of
that person's claim and asking for
an order directing payment of the
surplus money. The Sheriff or other
person conducting the sale will
have information regarding the
surplus, if any,
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of ONE HUNDRED TWENTY
ONE THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED
EIGHTY FOUR DOLLARS AND FIFTY
NINE CENTS ($121,984.59) dollars
more or less, plus interest together
with the costs of this sale. THE
UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT
TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff,
Attorney:
BROCK & SCOTT, PLLC.
302 FELLOWSHIP ROAD, SUITE 130
MOUNT LAUREL, NJ 08054,
Dated: 4/7, 4/14, 4/21, 4/28/2026
